description:
Your skin deserves 72 hours of pure, luxurious hydration – every single day. ✨ 

Introducing Be Bodywise 1% Hyaluronic Acid Body Wash Mousse –your ultimate winter essential for deeply nourished, ultra-hydrated skin 

🌟  Intense Hydration for 72 Hours: Infused with Hyaluronic Acid, this formula leaves your skin hydrated and plump for up to 72 hours.
🌟Relieve Dryness: Say goodbye to flaky, dry patches and hello to silky-smooth skin.

faqs.question: Can I use Hyaluronic Acid Body Wash every day?
faqs.answer: Yes, we recommend using this body wash for all skin types once a day, every day.

faqs.question: Is cleanser good for all skin types?
faqs.answer: Yes - this body wash can be used by all skin types, especially dry skin types

faqs.question: Can I use this twice a day?
faqs.answer: We recommend seeking expert advice to verify the same.

faqs.question: How much time will it take to see results?
faqs.answer: We recommend checking with an expert as results will vary depending on the condition: however you should start noticing a change within 3 months

faqs.question: Can I use this as a shaving cream?
faqs.answer: Yes, since it is foamy, it can replace the need of using shaving cream
